dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The trip was way too short!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: I definitely agree! It's a wonderful thing, isn't it? Traveling on the elevated aquabus lane, taking in the sights here in Fontaine, growing old with the aquabus...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Um, but changing the route might be kinda tough. Uh, maybe we could slow the boat down a bit? That way, the time taken will increase. Hehe, Aeval, you're so smart! That's what we'll suggest...
